Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 7
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the requirement “first published” and, despite acknowledging Britannica’s statement that Crime and Punishment was first published (serially) in 1866, gave the final answer as 1867 (the book edition). This synthesis error conflated first publication with first book publication, producing the wrong year.
